final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, COUNT(*) AS n, 1.0*SUM(t.Bytes)/SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId=t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(r.n) AS avg_tracks, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_margin FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate
